body: ## Pull request overview This PR fixes a failure-mode in the `VC3D` Qt test suite where a failed QTest check inside `expectSingleCompletion()` would only return from the helper function, allowing the test slot to continue and potentially segfault by indexing an empty `QSignalSpy` (as reported in #1318). Converting the helper into a macro ensures QTest’s `return`-based failure behavior aborts the *calling test slot*, keeping failures diagnosable and preventing the rest of the test binary from being taken down. **Changes:** - Replace `expectSingleCompletion(QSignalSpy&)` helper function with `EXPECT_SINGLE_COMPLETION(...)` macro so failed checks abort the calling test slot. - Update all call sites to use the new macro, preserving existing diagnostics and behavior while avoiding out-of-bounds spy access after a failed check. --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews.
